s-1.ptxt: Inspect Front Tires for Straight-ahead Position
Secure Steering Wheel

s2.ptxt: To prevent the spiral cable from breaking, secure the steering wheel with the seat belt so that it does not turn.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Column Hole Cover Silencer Sheet

s2.ptxt: Turn back the floor carpet, remove the 2 clips, and remove the column hole cover silencer sheet.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Steering Intermediate Shaft Assembly NO.2

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt from steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2.
Slide steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 toward the steering column assembly until the serrations of the steering intermediate shaft are visible.

atten3.ptxt: Do not disconnect steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 from the steering intermediate shaft.

s2.ptxt: Put matchmarks on steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 and the steering intermediate shaft.
Disconnect steering intermediate shaft assembly No.2 from the steering intermediate shaft.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Steering Column Hole Cover Sub-assembly NO.1

s2.ptxt: Push clip B toward the center of the cover, push down clip A, and disconnect steering column hole cover No.1 from the floor panel.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Tire
Remove Engine Under Cover NO.1
Remove Engine Under Cover NO.2
Remove Engine Under Cover Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 clips and the engine under cover rear LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Tie Rod End Sub-assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the cotter pin and castle nut.
Install SST to the tie rod end LH.

atten3.ptxt: Install SST so that its upper end is aligned with that of the tie rod end LH.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, disconnect the tie rod end LH from the steering knuckle.

item.ptxt: To prevent SST from falling, always tie the string to the steering knuckle so that it does not slacken.
Install the SST so that A and B of the SST are parallel.
Be sure to apply the wrench at the position shown in the illustration.
Do not damage the ball joint boot of the tie rod end.
Do not damage the steering knuckle.
Do not damage the front disc brake dust cover.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Tie Rod End Sub-assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Stabilizer Link Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and disconnect the front stabilizer link assembly LH from the front stabilizer bar.

atten3.ptxt: Using hexagon wrench 6, hold the stud bolt so that it does not spin.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Stabilizer Link Assembly RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and 2 nuts.
Push down the front suspension lower arm No.1 LH and disconnect it from the front lower ball joint LH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Loosen Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Using SST, loosen the bolts.
Loosen bolt A.

atten3.ptxt: Turn bolt A while holding the nut in place.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Front Mounting Bracket Reinforcement Lower

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and the engine front mounting bracket reinforcement lower.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Reinforcement LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and front suspension member reinforcement LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Reinforcement RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Brace Rear LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 bolts and the front suspension member brace rear LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Brace Rear RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Crossmember Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 nuts, and disconnect the engine mounting insulator rear from the front suspension crossmember.
Support the front suspension crossmember with a transmission jack or equivalent
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the front suspension crossmember together with the steering gear assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Arm Sub-assembly Lower NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and nut, and remove front suspension lower arm No. 1 LH from the front suspension crossmember.

atten3.ptxt: Turn bolt A while holding nut B in place.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Brace Front LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 4 bolts and remove the front suspension member brace FR LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Suspension Member Brace Front RH

atten4.ptxt: Use the same procedure for the RH side as for the LH side.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Stabilizer Bar Front

s2.ptxt: Remove the front stabilizer bar and the 2 front stabilizer bar bushings No.1 from the front suspension crossmember.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Stabilizer Bar Bushing NO.1
